intro: Five quick questions about how your team works with data. Takes under two minutes. You’ll get a short snapshot at the end, and you don’t need to give your email.

questions.legend: How does your team build its main reports today?
Roughly how many hours a week does your team spend collecting, copying and fixing data?
Do your reports agree with each other?
How many systems hold your important data?
What decision would you make faster if your data was ready?
questions.hint: Optional. It’s quoted back in your snapshot and never leaves your browser.

levels.name: Early
levels.text: Your data is working against you. The good news: the first fixes are usually the biggest wins.

levels.name: Developing
levels.text: You have the pieces. Connecting them is what unlocks reliable reporting and AI.

levels.name: Ready
levels.text: Your foundations look solid. You may be ready to pilot an AI use case on top.

recommendations.text: Bring your main sources into one place before adding new tools.
Agree one definition for your key numbers, so every report tells the same story.
Automate the weekly refresh. That time comes straight back to your team.
Map your systems first. A short review shows which ones matter most.
Pick one AI use case and test it on the data you already trust.

fallback: A Data & AI Readiness Review turns this snapshot into a costed plan.
label: A rough self-assessment based on your answers, not a diagnosis.
